@BitPay ’s #dogecoin support gives $DOGE a more meaningful use case than most other cryptos. 🤣

Refill your BitPay @Mastercard with DOGE has a nice ring to it.
An acquaintance is asking me how to buy Ethereum. Do I explain that he can’t buy Ethereum but he can buy Ether, or do I just suck it up and be grateful he isn’t asking about #dogecoin?
